serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
My headaches and other…{{wi}} things…
I think there might be something wrong going on with me.
Might be...
I could always wait a bit more and see if this is just a temporary thing.
It’s not like people never recovered from such mild symptoms. T-there is no need to panic!
R-right?!
Ugh! {{wi}}My head feels like it’s about to burst again…
I don’t know how long I can keep up living like this. It’s getting really hard to do even the simplest of tasks. Even getting up from the bed takes its toll on me.
The worst thing about this whole situation is that…{{wi}} I’m more and more keen on the idea of contacting that fucker Blaubleim... 
He’s a trash human being and my family spent a few thousand dollars on his therapy and the results are questionable.
My mom picked this ‘big city doctor’ only because he showed up on her favourite news show.
For me he is just a sham who started promoting some fishy drugs as soon as he got a little bit popular.
Now Dr. Blaubleim is a full fledged pharmaceutical micro celebrity of some sort.
I never liked his attitude, being all smirky all the time, but after he gained even more publicity he became unbearable…
The price of a visit went from 200$ to 300$, because of inflation. I can understand that, everything got more expensive.
But why would this fucker change the time of it from 30 minutes to 15?!
What can he even accomplish in such an amount of time?!
This guy is swimming in money because of his advertising deals, but still is ripping off his patients…
How much money can one person want?
He can easily afford a yacht, some fast car, apartment in New York, whatever he wishes for while people like me are struggling and need to do some fucked up shit to survive…
Just thinking about it makes me mad!
But there is something he’s better than most of the other doctors…
He’s so concerned about his PR that he will never send me to a psychiatric hospital. It would put in a bad light and he wouldn’t like that. 
Not. One. Bit.
I’m not a big fan of being closed with a bunch of weirdos for the rest of my life and with my…{{wi}} symptoms it’s not improbable.
If I want to see a psychiatrist and live normally after the first visit, Blaubleim is my only safe choice…
My goofy mother already paid him beforehand so it’s not like I will waste my own money.
What should I do?
